summary:
Our project is about the different space machines and equipment that NASA has left behind on the Moon, Mars and other parts of space. These include rovers, landers, probes and scientific instruments that were sent for different space missions.

Even though many of these machines have completed their missions, they still have interesting stories and have helped scientists learn many things about space. Through this project, we want to explore these machines, understand why they were sent, what they did and how they contributed to space exploration.

We are planning to present this information through an interactive platform with maps, pictures, 3D models and simple explanations so that students and other people can easily understand it. Our main aim is to make learning about space more interesting and help people discover the stories behind these forgotten machines.

We believe that even if their missions are over, their contribution to space science should never be forgotten.

Project Details – Echoes of Space

The Untold Stories of Forgotten Space Machines

Our project, Echoes of Space, is about exploring the space equipment that NASA has left behind on the Moon, Mars and other parts of space. It focuses on rovers, landers, probes, descent stages and scientific instruments that were sent for different space missions.

1. What does the project do and how does it work?

Our idea is to create an interactive educational platform where people can learn about forgotten space machines. Users will be able to explore maps of the Moon and Mars, view different space machines, and learn about their missions, locations, purposes and discoveries. We also plan to use pictures, 3D models and simple stories to explain how these machines worked and what they achieved during their missions.

2. What are the benefits of the project?

This project makes learning about space more interesting and easier for everyone. Many people know about current NASA missions but do not know much about the machines that completed their missions years ago. Our project helps people discover their importance and understand how they contributed to space science. It can also help students learn about science, technology and space exploration in an interesting way.

3. What is the intended impact of the project?

Our main aim is to make people understand that even machines that have stopped working can have great scientific and historical importance. We want to encourage students and young people to become more interested in astronomy, science and space technology. We also hope to preserve the stories of these machines and inspire future generations to explore space.

4. What tools, coding languages, hardware or software did you use?

Our proposed platform can be developed using HTML, CSS and JavaScript to create an interactive website. We plan to use 3D modelling tools for spacecraft models, maps to show the locations of different machines, and animation tools to explain their missions. Audio, video and other digital resources can also be used to make the learning experience better.

5. How is the project creative?

The creative part of our project is that we are telling the stories of space machines that are often forgotten. Instead of only showing scientific facts, we want to present their journeys and missions in a simple and interesting storytelling format. Interactive maps, 3D models, illustrations and animations will help users feel more connected to the history of space exploration.

6. What factors did our team consider?

While planning this project, we considered scientific accuracy, creativity, accessibility and educational value. We want to make sure that the information is reliable and easy to understand, especially for school students. We also considered making the platform simple to use, interesting for different age groups and useful for people who want to learn more about space.

Our goal is simple: to bring forgotten space machines back to life through their stories and show the world that their contributions will never be forgotten.
